# Copilot instructions for mesa-26-gororoba

`AGENTS.md` at the repository root is the canonical instruction source for this repository, and Copilot follows it for every task. It holds the build, test, and lint doctrine (day-to-day work runs through `make -C build-infra`, with `build-infra/README.md` listing the profiles and commands), the evidence and conformance rules, the NIR-first compiler direction, and the commit and comment conventions. This file stays a loader and carries no rules of its own.
